headline: Committee cuts fire funds, passes Lahaina land trust grant and housing bonds

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.voteItem: Decrease fire administration Category A appropriation by $94,556
meeting.summary: Cuts included $94,556 for fire administration positions and $65,000 for a fire department vehicle. Members passed a $6 million grant and $4.5 million in bonds for homes for domestic violence victims, each with nine ayes, then recessed during a $3 million Affordable Housing Fund motion.
meeting.recap: The committee cut $94,556 for fire administration positions still being reorganized.[[0:16:29]] The committee cut $65,000 meant to buy one fire department vehicle.[[0:24:43]] A cut for ceremonial uniforms passed on a roll call vote: six ayes, one no, two excused.[[0:29:41]] A motion to raise the aerial fireworks fee to $1,100 was withdrawn because state law sets it.[[0:37:13]] A member proposed raising an explosive materials permit fee from $100 to $500 a year.[[0:40:21]] The committee set that proposal aside so attorneys could research it.[[0:47:16]] Tamara Paltin moved a new $6 million grant to the Lahaina Community Land Trust.[[0:49:43]] She said it would help wildfire survivors with a gap in rebuilding money.[[0:50:00]] The grant passed with nine ayes.[[0:54:12]] A member moved $4.5 million in bonds to buy homes to lease to domestic violence victims.[[0:54:44]] That motion passed with nine ayes.[[1:06:03]] A member moved to add $3 million in the Affordable Housing Fund for a housing program.[[1:09:41]] The committee took a recess while that motion was still under discussion.[[1:19:23]]
decided: The cut passed; it reduces funding by four months for four fire administration positions still in reorganization.
Members voted aye by voice, but the result was not stated in the captions.
The cut passed with seven ayes and two members excused.
A voice vote was called, but the result was not stated in the captions.
The motion was made and seconded, but no vote on it appears in the captions.
meeting.next: The committee will come back to the explosive materials fee after attorneys research it. The member who cut the Ocean Safety funds said she plans to move the money elsewhere during countywide items. A director said the council would need to pass a resolution to approve each county home purchase. A member said the voluntary deed restriction program should announce its launch soon after a bill passed on Friday.

issues.oneLine: A member proposed $4.5 million in county bonds to buy homes to lease as housing for domestic violence victims.
issues.why: The member said a domestic violence hotline's calls doubled after the fires while rents rose and housing became scarce.

deadlines.d: by the end of December 2027, 18 months
deadlines.t: Bond funds for the domestic violence housing purchases must be encumbered (committed).

issues.next: The council would still need to approve each property purchase by resolution.
issues.brief: A director said bond funds for the purchases must be committed by the end of December 2027.[[#1]] The budget director said bond funds can also be used to renovate county-owned homes.[[#2]] The motion passed with nine ayes.[[#3]]
